nodes.description: Public uint256 total supply of the CharityCommonweal token, set once in the constructor.
Public mapping(address => uint256) holding each account token balance; mutated in transfer and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending allowances; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Public string token name assigned in the constructor.
Public uint8 number of decimals assigned in the constructor.
Public string token symbol assigned in the constructor.
Private constant 2**256 - 1 used to skip the allowance decrement for infinite approvals.
Constructor: credits _initialAmount to msg.sender and initializes totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
Public transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): checks sender balance then debits sender and credits recipient.
Public transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): checks balance and allowance, moves tokens, then decrements the allowance unless it is MAX_UINT256.
Public view returning the token balance of _owner from the balances mapping.
Public approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Public view returning the remaining allowance of _spender for _owner.
Caller-controlled address used as the source of funds and as the allowance owner in transfer, transferFrom, approve and the constructor.
arithmetic: balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer; unchecked unsigned subtraction relying only on the preceding require.
arithmetic: balances[_to] += _value in transfer; unchecked unsigned addition that can overflow.
arithmetic: balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom; unchecked unsigned addition that can overflow and is executed before the sender is debited.
arithmetic: balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; unchecked unsigned subtraction relying on the preceding require.
arithmetic: allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom, guarded only by the allowance < MAX_UINT256 condition.
_initialAmount: constructor parameter used as the initial supply and initial balance of msg.sender.
_tokenName: constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_decimalUnits: constructor parameter assigned to the decimals state variable.
_tokenSymbol: constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
_to: transfer recipient address used as the key of the balances mapping.
_value: transfer amount used in the balance subtraction and addition.
_from: transferFrom source address used to index balances and allowed.
_to: transferFrom recipient address used as the key of the balances mapping.
_value: transferFrom amount used for the balance updates and allowance decrement.
allowance: local variable caching allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
_owner: balanceOf lookup key.
balance: return variable of balanceOf holding balances[_owner].
_spender: approve target address used as the inner key of allowed.
_value: approve amount written into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_owner: allowance lookup outer key.
_spender: allowance lookup inner key.
remaining: return variable of allowance holding allowed[_owner][_spender].
